content:
We have a new release candidate of Lean, v4.34.0-rc1. See the release notes for more information.

The usual repos are all available with the new toolchain at their respective v4.34.0-rc1 tags (and ProofWidgets at v0.0.109). We encourage all projects downstream to update to v4.34.0-rc1 when possible, and to release their own corresponding
toolchain tags after updating.
